input.standard: ASTM E741 concentration decay; ASTM D6245 occupant CO2 tracer
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the served air volume of /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v3, from the occupied-zone CO2 rise and full-speed decay.
hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone during the test.
The closed /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v3 remains in one position throughout; residual exchange with /habitat/hab-b is not measured and is negligible relative to the fitted Lab decay.
FE-3 remains in the Lab at steady activity for the whole test; any entry, exit, or additional occupant invalidates the curve.
The scrubber effective flow follows its registered speed-dependent performance after its lag.
The full-speed decay approaches a nonzero occupied-zone equilibrium and is fitted as C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau); V_lab = Qe * tau.

monitoring.reason: The test deliberately raises occupied-zone CO2; stop on an out-of-band vital sign, loss of monitoring, or occupancy change.

steps.why: Hold the Lab as one zone and reduce effective scrubber flow so occupant CO2 rises several hundred ppm above sensor noise; record Lab and Hab-B CO2, speed command and acceptance at one-minute intervals.
Keep the same zone boundary, return the scrubber to full speed, record both zones and command acceptance each minute, and fit the Lab decay toward its nonzero equilibrium.

abort.when: Lab CO2 is at or above 3000 ppm.
The scrubber refuses either commanded speed.
Battery state of charge is under the threshold percent.
FE-3 is outside the stated heart-rate band, monitoring is lost, or any additional person is detected in the Lab.

expected.rise: At 30 percent speed, Lab CO2 should rise by several hundred ppm while remaining below the test maximum; failure to rise above sensor noise rejects the usable-excitation hypothesis.
expected.decay: At 100 percent speed, Lab CO2 should follow a monotonic exponential approach to a nonzero equilibrium after scrubber lag; a poor exponential fit rejects the one-zone, steady-source, or registered-flow hypotheses.
expected.volume: Fit tau from C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau), then report V_lab = Qe * tau in m3 using the scrubber effective flow at full speed.
expected.connectedZone: Hab-B CO2 should not track the Lab transient closely while the hatch is closed; correlated change indicates material inter-zone exchange and rejects the negligible-exchange hypothesis.
expected.validity: Any occupancy change, hatch-position change, refused speed command, safety abort, or loss of required one-minute records invalidates the volume result.

justifications.reason: Lowest speed allowed by signed rule.
Signed minimum battery state of charge.
